title: simulation controlled simulation pilot
purpose: Finite method-behavior pilot; not evidence that any real VS gene is composition-only or tumor-intrinsic.
estimand: Common within-compartment log2 tumor effect beta[g] under a fixed composition.

equations.analysis_scale: Y[i,g] = log2(L[i,g]) + epsilon[i,g], epsilon iid Normal(0, 0.12^2)
equations.fixed_composition_identity: With epsilon=0 and the same p in both groups, log2(L_tumor[g]/L_control[g]) = beta[g].

analysis_scale.platform_scope: Continuous microarray-like generated expression with a count-valued reference; no claim of validated real-platform/noise equivalence.

background.use: Pooled normalized-expression means for six compartments supply a shared group-independent background only; no VS-versus-nerve effects or real fitted outcomes are used as truth.

gene_allocation.reserved_unaffected_markers: 50 non-overlapping high-specificity markers per each of six compartments (300 total); excluded from target classes.
gene_allocation.beta_nonzero: 50 target expression-only genes at +1.5 and 50 at -1.5; 50 target both genes at +1.5 and 50 at -1.5; all other genes beta=0.

separation.control_center_source: bulk-model audited MuSiC composition group means, normalized to sum one.
separation.tumor_center_source: bulk-model audited MuSiC composition group means, normalized to sum one.

mixtures.seed_formula: 2026101500 + 100*scenario_index + repeat_index; overlap index=1, separation index=2; no redraws.

routes: oracle: limma ~ group + five CLR PCs from true cell fractions
estimated: actual MuSiC 1.0.0 with explicit reserved markers and normalize=TRUE, then limma ~ group + five CLR PCs from estimated fractions
metrics: coefficient bias and absolute error versus beta
warning: Oracle CLR-PC adjustment is not guaranteed unbiased because log(sum_c p_c*mu_gc) may be nonlinear in five CLR PCs. Coefficient error against beta includes this functional-form mismatch and does not label the fitted coefficient biological truth.
